notes.title: Orbital Drop Shipping - Patch 1.11
notes.content:
Hello Drop-Shippers!

Here's the patch notes for Orbital Drop Shipping v1.11

[list]
[*] Fixed an error with cannon prices in the level editor
[*] Fixed an error with saving map name in the level editor
[*] Fixed an error with saving info to custom levels
[/list]

Want to play a level? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3166806609]Try Lunatic![/url]

-Troy

notes.title: Orbital Drop Shipping - Patch 1.10
notes.content:
Hello Drop-Shippers!

Here's the patch notes for Orbital Drop Shipping v1.10

[list]
[*] Fixed an error with the awarding of level completion Steam Achievements

[/list]

Looking for a level to play? Try [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3161937585]Triple Threat from the STEAM Workshop![/url]

-Troy
